description: Search official FARA daily snapshots of registrants, foreign principals or short-form registrants, or fetch one registration's live foreign-principal, short-form or document collection. Short forms are the individuals working under a registration, searched by first and last name; a hit is a name match only and establishes no identity across registrations or with LDA lobbyists. Each call returns page_size whole records; follow next_cursor through the pinned result. Principal and short-form status differ from registrant status (registrant_status). Disclosure records do not establish wrongdoing or influence.

country.description: Exact represented country/location label, foreign-principal search only.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation; original filters may be omitted or repeated unchanged.

detail.description: Detail collection, default foreign_principals; unavailable in search mode.

entity.description: Search entity, default registrants; short_forms finds the individuals filed under a registration by first and last name. Unavailable in detail mode.

mode.description: Search daily snapshots or fetch one registration detail collection; defaults to search.

name_contains.description: Search-only literal case-insensitive token-AND match over entity names; a short-form name is its first and last name joined. Short-form hits are name matches only, with no identity across registrations or with LDA lobbyists.

page_size.description: Whole records per window, default 25, at most 1,000; larger values clamp to 1,000 and are disclosed in delivery_limits. Part of the scope: omit it or repeat it unchanged on continuations.

registration_number.description: Lossless digit-string registration number, required for detail mode.

status.description: Status of the selected record itself, default active; documents require all.

name: uslobbying_search_foreign_agents

attribution.description: Required verbatim attribution for LDA data.

complete.description: Whether every source partition has been exhausted.

upstream_count.description: Latest partition counts summed only when all are known; includes duplicates, not an immutable snapshot.

delivery_limits.description: Clamped controls for this call; an empty map means no clamp. Immediate cursor replay retains its original values.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Required detail identifier is absent, selectors conflict, country/status is invalid, or page_size exceeds 1,000 where clamping is disabled. `cursor_invalid`: Continuation is unavailable, expired, belongs to another tenant, or arrives with changed filters or page_size. `acquisition_storage_unavailable`: Retained-data capacity prevents a safe checkpoint. `source_schema_changed`: A source response violates the verified schema or uses an unsupported redirect. `snapshot_unavailable`: Required bulk snapshot cannot be downloaded or decoded. `source_rate_limited`: FARA returns HTTP 429 after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation to the next window.

output_complete.description: Whether every matched record has been delivered.

records.description: Whole normalized records delivered in this window.

items.description: FARA entity with complete original source fields.

country.description: Source represented country/location label; never guessed ISO code.

date_stamped.description: Normalized document stamped calendar date if known.

document_url.description: Official URL returned by document source.

raw.description: Complete validated source record, original keys and values.

registration_date.description: Normalized calendar registration date if known.

status.description: Selected entity status; omitted for documents.

termination_date.description: Selected entity calendar termination date if known.

records_returned.description: Whole records delivered in this window.

total_matches.description: Exact matched records in the pinned acquisition.

truncated.description: More records remain through next_cursor; no source data was discarded.
